description: Wipe-tower solid contact layers, interface temperatures, pre-extrusion and bed clipping.

mutants.description: Contact and Contact_UP grid layers have the 20 mm/s feedrate
Every solid/contact result has a balanced grid marker and positive extrusion
Interface temperature and pre-extrusion are emitted only through the contact full-block gate
Large negative pre-extrusion distance is clipped to the translated bed minimum
Large positive pre-extrusion distance is clipped to the translated bed maximum
Configured interface temperature wait is present in contact output
Configured interface pre-extrusion move is present before contact grid
Contact output restores the nozzle temperature after the interface grid

mutants.old:
writer
            .append(";--------------------\n"
                    "; CP EMPTY GRID START\n")
            .comment_with_value(" layer #", m_num_layer_changes + 1);
mutants.description: Solid/contact geometry is delimited as a grid in emitted output
